name: Cafe Tennladen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Café Tennladen in Tirol**

Discover the cozy charm of **Café Tennladen**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Here, tradition meets modern comfort in a warm, inviting atmosphere. Start your day with a rich **Kaffee mit Schlag** or indulge in our famous **Apfelstrudel**—baked fresh daily. For a hearty breakfast, try our **Tiroler Bergkäse** with fresh bread, while sweet tooths will love our **Kaiserschmarrn** with vanilla sauce.

In the evenings, unwind with a glass of local **Apfelwein** or a creamy **Eierlikör**, paired perfectly with our homemade pastries. Whether you're exploring **Innsbruck**, taking a scenic hike in the **Zillertal**, or simply relaxing in the **Alpen**, **Café Tennladen** is your perfect stop for authentic **Tiroler** flavors and hospitality.
